name: daiver-prompt-view
description: A Claude Code mod that shows what your session is doing: a status line under the prompt with live agents, usage limits and git state, a framed chat with copy buttons, and a pane with your prompt history

borders.title: Show the frames
borders.description: The frames around your prompts, Claude's replies, tool calls, the spinner, command output and the status line (also /daiver-prompt-view:chat:show-borders [on|off])

chatBorders.title: Show the chat's frames
chatBorders.description: The frames around your prompts, Claude's replies, tool calls, the spinner and command output, on their own: drawn while this and the frames option are both on (also /daiver-prompt-view:chat:show-chat-borders [on|off])

statuslineBorders.title: Show the status line's frame
statuslineBorders.description: The frame around the status line, on its own: drawn while this and the frames option are both on (also /daiver-prompt-view:chat:show-statusline-borders [on|off])

statuslineUsage.title: Show the session's tokens and cost
statuslineUsage.description: The session's input and output tokens and its cost at the end of the status line's first line, as <in:1.2M·out:85k·cost:$4.31> (also /daiver-prompt-view:statusline:show-usage [on|off])

statuslineWeekReset.title: Show the weekly limit's reset date and time
statuslineWeekReset.description: The local date and time the weekly limit resets, after its percentage in the status line's lmt brackets, as (12% -> 25-11-2026 09:30); off, only the percentage (also /daiver-prompt-view:statusline:show-week-reset [on|off])

statuslineView.title: Status line's usage bars
statuslineView.description: How the status line draws the ctx, lmt, rst and pch bars: line-view (one line, ctx lmt rst pch, no rules, no block around Clawd) or block-view (two lines between rules, ctx | lmt and pch | rst, Clawd in a block of his own) (also /daiver-prompt-view:statusline:view <block-view|line-view>)

borderStyle.title: Frame style
borderStyle.description: How every frame is drawn: dashed or line (a solid one) (also /daiver-prompt-view:chat:border-style <dashed|line>)

statuslinePadding.title: Status line padding
statuslinePadding.description: Columns added to Claude Code's own 2 on each side of the status line: -1 leaves 1, -2 none, 1 leaves 3. The mod sets statusLine.padding to it while the status line runs its script, and the frame widens to match

agentActivityLength.title: Subagent's current work length
agentActivityLength.description: The most characters of a subagent's current work (its last tool call) shown in parentheses on its status line row, the cut end marked with …; 0 hides it

history.title: Show the prompt history pane
history.description: A pane at the right with the prompts you sent this session, framed in the theme's history color; its × closes it (also /daiver-prompt-view:history:show [on|off])

historyMode.title: Prompt history pane's messages
historyMode.description: What the prompt history pane lists: fullstory (your prompts and slash commands at the right, Claude's answers and tool calls at the left), questions (your prompts and slash commands alone) or answers (Claude's answers and tool calls alone) (also /daiver-prompt-view:history:mode <fullstory|questions|answers>)

buttons.title: Show the buttons row
buttons.description: A row above the prompt with two switches: the borders (b) and the prompt history pane (h), each showing whether it is on; a click, or its key while the row holds the focus (ctrl+x tab), turns it (also /daiver-prompt-view:chat:show-buttons [on|off])

toasts.title: Show the toasts
toasts.description: Claude Code's own toast: Task complete when Claude's turn ends with its answer, /-Command complete when a slash command you ran has finished (also /daiver-prompt-view:toasts:show [on|off])

clodik.title: Show Clawd
clodik.description: Clawd, Claude's mascot, at the right edge of the status line, animated while Claude Code is busy

clodikAnimate.title: Animate Clawd always
clodikAnimate.description: Clawd animates all the time, not only while Claude Code is busy (also /daiver-prompt-view:clodik:animate [on|off])

clodikAnimation.title: Clawd's animation
clodikAnimation.description: The animation Clawd plays, or a random one every few seconds (also /daiver-prompt-view:clodik:animation <name>)

theme.title: Color theme
theme.description: The status line's colors, the agents line's included (also /daiver-prompt-view:view:theme <name>)
